gappers.catalyst: Neocloud sell-off after Microsoft's lower-than-expected capex (CNBC 10/28); AI-infra scalability worries.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Microsoft's capex came in below expectations, read as infrastructure partners (CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN) taking longer to deliver capacity; neoclouds fell after-hours 10/28 and Alphabet's ~11% drop on 10/30 deepened the AI rout.
gappers.why: Lower hyperscaler capex cuts expected neocloud contract/backlog growth; high-beta, debt-funded names de-rate hardest.
gappers.impact: Sector-wide (CRWV -12.7%, GOOG -13%, ORCL -7.3% same tape). Premarket vol only 383k so far; reads as capitulation gap, mean-revert bounce possible but trend broken.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM, sector-sentiment gap, no company-specific news; falling-knife until capex narrative stabilizes.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Would displace a healthier holding; R:R vs a 7-10% stop on a 13% gap is poor; CRWV/NBIS are correlated (corr gate), only one could be taken; GOOG/ORCL setups are not better. Fails 2:1 until it basing.

gappers.catalyst: Alphabet plunged ~11-13% on earnings/AI-capex reaction; drags Nasdaq-100 >1% (Schwab).
gappers.catalyst_detail: Alphabet's post-earnings plunge (~11% per Schwab, -13% in Alpaca premarket) hit the AI complex; Amazon and Intel also fell on disappointing results/guidance, with defensives bid.
gappers.why: Earnings/guidance disappointment plus capex worries removes the premium multiple; index-heavy name forces passive/ETF selling.
gappers.impact: Heavy volume (2.96M premarket) = real repricing, not thin. Sector read-through negative for AI infra (NBIS/CRWV/ORCL).
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM, a gap-down on guidance usually needs days to base; LONG_TERM thesis would need a reset on earnings detail not yet reviewed.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Largest cap, most liquid; but buying a -13% gap violates patience rule. Would displace nothing cleanly; stop distance at 10% trail makes R:R sub-2:1 unless gap fills. Watch for support hold.
